name: Tzatziki Pasta Salad with Tuna, Mixed Veggies, Olives & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place tzatziki, vinaigrette, and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups tzatziki sauce
⅓ cup balsamic vinaigrette
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna. Add to the bowl with the dressing and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and small dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl along with the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice olives. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl with the tuna and veggies, then stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and top with feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
